subfamily: old-school Daisy (Oxford DAISY pdf 627: a sour sweetened with a liqueur or syrup, a splash of sparkling water, a cocktail glass; Imbibe! pdf 105-106: the orange cordial an accent, not the main sweetener; Codex p. 106: a small liqueur is seasoning, so by structure a sour)
glass: fine stemmed cocktail glass (about 210 ml), chilled, no ice
_status: v1 (Tomas, round 2). Bourbon as a style, 45% or stronger. Spark: two teaspoons of dry vermouth (Chappell's 'start liking it', Proper p. 102). Note: shaken is not a staged style in balance.py, so the tool counts the 15 ml splash as shaken in; staged truth (fizz-style run, judged by hand on shaken ranges) in the draft's Checks.
